children: on Tuesday said it is rolling out a new subscription service, Meta One, that gives users expanded access to artificial intelligence tools and additional features across Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, and Meta AI.

Plans for this service are now available globally, starting at $2.99 a month for individual products, $7.99 for individual bundles, and $14.99 for creator and business bundles. This includes more than 50 features at launch, with plans to expand to Edits and AI glasses over time. Meta
said its core apps and Meta AI will remain free, while subscriptions provide additional AI usage and specialized capabilities.

For individual users, the company offers single-product subscriptions as well as Core and Premium bundles. The latter provides greater access to AI-powered image and video generation, as well as tools such as Instagram’s Restyle. Meta
said more than half of subscribers in early testing used both AI and expression features in its bundled plans.

is also offering subscription tiers for creators and businesses, with tools including enhanced profiles, content scheduling, analytics, and greater access to Meta Business Agent for customer responses.

Business and creator plans range from Essential, starting at $14.99 a month, to Max, starting at $499 a month. The Facebook parent said pricing and available features may vary by region, app, and account.
The company said its individual single-product plans, including Instagram Plus, Facebook Plus, and WhatsApp Plus, have shown strong retention as the company continues to expand them.

title: Meta launches Meta One subscription service across its apps
